ShortDescription.Value: Removes the deterministic service-coverage merge stutter without changing coverage results.

Publish.LongDescription: Replaces a pathological linear-reinsertion merge in ServiceCoverageSystem with an equivalent monotone radix-queue merge. This diagnostic build adds runtime logging controls and a guarded park-removal test. It is locked to the analyzed Game.dll and fails closed on incompatible game versions.

ChangeLog.Value: Added runtime start/stop coverage logging and a guarded hotkey for the park-removal A/B diagnostic without restarting the game.
